title: Audit Pack
summary: Cross-phase bundle for status review, risk discovery, regression checking, and delivery-quality audits.
when_to_use: Use this when a build feels unstable, unclear, late, or over-scoped and you need a structured review pass.
required_inputs: Known blockers, bugs, and risk areas
Performance, UI, or onboarding pain points
starter_steps: Run a project-status audit to expose the current bottlenecks.
Triage the known bugs and regression risk first.
Review build acceptance, performance, and readability together.
End with a concrete risk list and a fix order.
